_comment:
'Your next dagger attack this turn gets +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, mark them." / **Go again**' Warrior Action (TheHunted - derive the json/<set>/ folder from setIdentifiers at adoption).

GO AGAIN NOT AUTHORED: GoAgain is in printed_keywords as an UNCONDITIONAL line of the text, so it fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring it would be a defect. It is also not the conditional-keyword case - nothing gates it, so no SOURCE_IS_ATTACK machinery applies.

ABILITY TYPE PLAY: type_text is plain 'Warrior Action', NOT 'Action - Attack', so the effects ride a PLAY ability resolving when the card is played (felling_swing/hit_and_run family precedent).

PUMP: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK reads mod/amount/filter/scope (effect_types.py:4592-4618, read this session) and queues a one-shot entry on the CONTROLLER's dsl_queued_attack_mods; consumption (engine.py:1175-1236) compiles the filter against each incoming attack and applies+consumes on FIRST match - a non-dagger attack leaves it queued, which is exactly 'the NEXT dagger attack'. Unused entries expire end of turn = 'this turn'. Filter ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN reads 'subtypes' and unions the attack card's types AND subtypes (condition_types.py:296-316); daggers are weapons, which attack as themselves carrying the Dagger subtype.

MARK RIDER DEVIATES FROM A NAIVE READING OF THE TRIAGE LIST, deliberately and following adopted corpus precedent: INJECT_TRIGGER has no next-single-attack scope (COMBAT needs a current attack; TURN re-injects onto EVERY attack; CHAIN/NEXT_TURN wrong spans) - .triage/lace_with_bloodrot_red.json and .triage/ironsong_versus.json record the same sentence family as blocked on exactly this. The working composition, copied from .drafts/edge_ahead_red.json ('your next Warrior attack ... and "When this attacks a hero..."') and the high_striker/burn_up__shock fire-once idiom: scope TURN hook + NESTED trigger dict (required - a top-level conditions key would be popped by the loader as an effect-level gate evaluated once at registration, effect_types.py:2103-2119) whose inner conditions narrow to DAGGER attacks and a NOT FLAG_SET fire-once gate; the payoff MARK is wrapped in CONDITIONAL_EFFECT (effect_types.py:3697+, reads when/then - authoring 'conditions' there would be silently unread) gated on ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO, and SET_FLAG consumes the grant on the first qualifying dagger HIT regardless of target. Injected triggers fire with card=combat.attack_card, so MARK (defaults to the opposing hero, effect_types.py:1901-1924) and FLAG_SET resolve against the attacker - me, since the hook only arms while I am active.

DISCLOSED APPROXIMATIONS: (1) if the next dagger attack is fully BLOCKED, ON_HIT never fires, the flag stays unset, and a LATER dagger attack that hits a hero still marks - paper loses the rider with the missed attack. Unavoidable: turn_attack_hooks deliver only on ON_HIT (injected ON_ATTACK entries are consumed by nothing, per .drafts/high_speed_impact_blue.json's listener census). (2) The rider binds to 'first dagger that hits', not object-identity to 'the next dagger' - same class of approximation disclosed in .drafts/head_shot_red.json. (3) Two copies played in one turn share the flag, so they mark once between them where paper could mark twice (same disclosure as high_striker_red).
